description:
Position : Oracle Business Intelligence Enterprise Edition (OBIEE) Developer 
 
 Location : Atlanta, GA 
 
 Duration 3 Months 
 
 Only local candidates as F2F interview is required 
 
 Required Skills: 
 1. 2+ years of experience with OBIEE Answers, Dashboards, and BI Publisher 
 2. 2+ years of experience with star-schema, snowflake, FACT, and dimensional data modeling 
 3. 4 year Bachelor’s degree with preferred concentration in IT, data science, or business 
 4. 5+ years of experience as an Oracle BI development using OBIEE with deep expertise in RDP design/development 
 5. 5+ years of experience in writing PL/SQL, SQL*Plus, etc. 
 6. 8+ years of IT development experience 
 7. Ability to design reports in a logical, user friendly, and easy to understand format 
 8. Ability to extrapolate business requirements, practices, and procedures 
 9. Ability to meet deadlines and deliver high quality work products 
 10. Ability to meet deadlines, results oriented 
 11. Able to use complex expressions to calculate, group, filter, parameterize, optimize and format contents of reports/analytics 
 12. Accountable for actions within OBIEE production environment 
 13. Committed to ensuring data accuracy and quality within reports 
 14. Complete working knowledge of OBIEE user, object and data security and caching capabilities. 
 15. Demonstrated experience in designing, building, implementing, and deploying data universes/data models against Oracle and SQL Server databases 
 16. Excellent communication skills 
 17. Experience in data analysis, data profiling and validation 
 18. Experience in producing test cases/scenarios 
 19. Experience with Business Objects, Crystal Reports, and Reporting Services 
 20. Experience with creating dashboards and performance metric based reporting 
 21. Experience with deploying/upgrading BI systems 
 22. High level of customer service 
 23. Highly organized with the ability to multi-task 
 24. Must be able to write technical documentation 
 25. Must be skilled and experienced with graphical elements and filtered/layered reporting with drill down capabilities 
 26. Understand how to use XML, and XSL for advanced report features and formatting 
 27. •Demonstrated experience in designing, building, implementing, and deploying enterprise reports, analytics, and dashboards 
 28. •Strong knowledge of RDBMS – MS SQL Server 2008/2012, Oracle 11g/12c 
 
 Desired Skills: 
 
 1. Experience customizing BI reports using JSP, ASP, SDK 
 2. Experience in BI security and server administration 
 3. Experience with Crystal Reports and sub-reports 
 4. Experience with Microsoft SharePoint 
 5. Experience with Microsoft SSRS 
 6. Knowledge of Oracle Financials (PeopleSoft), and Primavera/P6 Analytics, Human Resources (Time and Labor), and Learning Management 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
years_evidence: 2+ years of experience with OBIEE Answers, Dashboards, and BI Publisher
